failure_summary.description: Some requested facets were missed or mapped to mismatched or redundant endpoints, including an overview request left uncovered.
Calls included an empty optional value or placed a parameter in the wrong group and used a value representation that did not match the expected format.
Search and country arguments did not match the expected market or canonical representation.

patch.reasoning: Most observed issues are already addressed by the skill’s endpoint-coverage, schema, and argument rules, so repeating them would add little. One gap is handling requested facets that have no dedicated endpoint but can be served by a configurable endpoint; clarifying this may prevent silently omitting such facets without encouraging unsupported calls.

edits.target: For a broad request, prefer a documented broad or all-scope endpoint when it fully provides the requested output; do not choose a narrower endpoint merely because it has fewer required arguments.
edits.content: Before treating a requested facet as unsupported because no dedicated endpoint exists, check whether a documented configurable endpoint can perform it through an operation or function selector. Use the matching selector when its value is established by the endpoint documentation or a standard, well-known value for that API; do not guess unsupported selectors or use an unrelated operation just to claim coverage.
